title: Street Corn Tacos
description: Elote's char-grilled corn, crema, cotija, and chili lime, folded into warm corn tortillas instead of served on the cob.

image.alt: Tacos with dipping sauce on a dark table, warm low light

ingredients: 1/3 cup Mexican crema (or sour cream thinned with a little lime juice)
1/2 tsp chili powder, plus more to serve
steps: Rub the corn with oil and grill over high heat (or char in a dry cast-iron pan), turning every 2 minutes, until blistered on all sides, about 10 minutes total. Let cool slightly, then cut the kernels off the cob.
Stir the crema, half the cotija, chili powder, cayenne, garlic, and lime juice into the warm corn kernels. Season with salt.
Warm the tortillas directly over a flame or in a dry skillet until lightly charred and pliable.
Fill each tortilla with the corn mixture.
Top with the remaining cotija, cilantro, and an extra pinch of chili powder. Serve with lime wedges.
note: Char the corn hard — the blistered kernels are most of the flavor here, more than any of the seasonings.
